description: Uzbekistan - Power Plant is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Hydropower, Thermal power", published or maintained by Naichen Zhao (World Bank Group). Data collected and prepared for a project of the World Bank Group Modernization and Upgrade of Transmission Substations project in Uzbekistan. This data is based on a digitized PDF map, and so is intended as a schematic of rough locations of the power network. It is not suitable for applications requiring high accuracy. Coverage: Uzbekistan. It has 5 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP, PDF. The portal files it under Hydropower, Thermal power, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
